subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should comment-loss diagnostics become optional fields on the exported `ConfigWriteResult` and `ConfigReplaceResult` contracts, or remain on the existing logger/console warning path?
rationale: Both approaches solve the visible CLI problem, but choosing a permanent structured result contract affects future config-write callers and warning semantics and cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Keep Existing Warning Channels
options.body: Remove the new result fields, keep stderr/logger warnings for normal writes, and avoid creating a one-off exported diagnostic contract.

options.title: Approve Structured Diagnostics
options.body: Keep the optional fields, explicitly approve their semantics as the config-write diagnostic contract, and retain focused caller and quiet-mode coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep Existing Warning Channels
recommendation.body: Remove the new result fields, keep stderr/logger warnings for normal writes, and avoid creating a one-off exported diagnostic contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to the config-write and warning behavior whose exported contract needs a decision.
